changes: Upstream generated illustration and background extraction retained exactly. FederFunk adds source, licence and credit metadata only; decoded RGBA pixels, alpha, pose and colours are unchanged. Resizing, composition and display dithering happen at render time.

review_defaults.scope: Each native alpha image was inspected at full size and composited on a paper contact sheet for diagnostic field marks, number of birds, wings, feet, tail, bounds, stray perches and retained background. Scientific names match recorded station labels. These are stylized generated illustrations, not untouched historical plates or confirmation of a sighting. Flight and sex variants are artistic choices, never conclusions drawn from audio confidence.

excluded_review_candidates.reason: The reviewed candidate omits the diagnostic white eyebrow of Mountain Chickadee and resembles Black-capped Chickadee; not admitted or relabelled.

assets.species_review: Black cap and bib, white cheek, gray flight feathers, buff flanks and short pointed bill match Black-capped Chickadee. The native pose closely matches the flying chickadee at the photo's lower left.
assets.figure_review: Single left-facing chickadee with raised right wing and extended left wing, curled feet and complete tail.

assets.species_review: Black cap and eye stripe, white eyebrow, blue-gray upperparts, straight slender bill and rusty breast match Red-breasted Nuthatch.
assets.figure_review: Single left-facing nuthatch, wings raised, feet tucked, full bill and short tail retained.

assets.species_review: Red forehead/face/chest, streaked pale belly, brown wings and stout seed-eating bill match a male House Finch. This is the red-headed flying bird at the centre of the supplied photo; sex/pose are artistic and are not inferred from the detection.
assets.figure_review: Single right-facing finch with one wing raised and the other extended, curled feet, complete tail and bill.

assets.species_review: Brown crown/eye stripes, pale eyebrow, streaked breast with central dark markings and conical bill match Song Sparrow; stylized marking proportions are retained.
assets.figure_review: Single right-facing sparrow, wings raised, feet curled and long tail extending down-left.

assets.species_review: Long slender curved bill, white throat, brown-gray head, rufous belly and barred tail match Canyon Wren.
assets.figure_review: Single left-facing wren with both wings extended, curled feet and barred tail.

assets.species_review: All-dark plumage, heavy bill, shaggy throat and long flight feathers support Common Raven in the upstream illustration; this is a stylized depiction, not a field-identification reference.
assets.figure_review: Single left-facing raven, open bill, opposing extended wings, curled feet and fanned tail.

assets.species_review: Dark plumage, more moderate bill and smoother throat than the paired raven support the upstream American Crow identification; stylized differences are not a claim of forensic identification.
assets.figure_review: Single right-facing crow with two raised wings, two tucked feet and complete fanned tail.

assets.species_review: Two ear tufts, yellow eyes, pale throat, barred underparts and feathered legs match Great Horned Owl.
assets.figure_review: Single owl descending with wings raised, head facing the viewer and both taloned feet visible.

assets.species_review: White eye ring, brown back, dark-spotted pale throat/breast and contrasting rufous tail support Hermit Thrush.
assets.figure_review: Single left-facing thrush with both wings raised, visible dangling legs and full rufous tail.

assets.species_review: Slender dark bill, peach-tan breast, dark wing/cheek spots and long pointed pale-edged tail match Mourning Dove.
assets.figure_review: Single left-facing dove with both wings spread, curled feet and a complete pointed tail.

assets.species_review: Red eye, blue-gray upperparts, rusty-barred breast, long rounded barred tail and yellow feet match the upstream Cooper's Hawk figure. Accipiter cooperii is retained exactly as reported by the station; no taxonomic alias is introduced.
assets.figure_review: Single left-facing hawk with wings raised, two yellow taloned feet and long rounded barred tail.
